actual_business.carrier: real encrypted QUIC carrying complete IP packets between ordinary owners
actual_business.os_path: actual root-owned namespaces, macvlan, TUN, nftables prefix DNAT/SNAT and conntrack
negative_cases: wrong authenticated peer at packet admission
normal_accounting_assertions: Both ordinary packet owners sent and received more than five complete packets.
Both original packet authorities accounted the same total complete-IP byte count.
Reapplying the consumed original business in its existing root journal was rejected; helper restart did not create a fresh kernel owner.

cleanup.normal_socket_EOF: both original helpers exited successfully and released their exact resources
cleanup.helper_SIGKILL: independent original journal recovery removed the recorded namespace and socket after worker/control-pipe termination
cleanup.ordinary_SIGSTOP: both root helpers independently failed closed during the seven-second ordinary-process suspension; after resume their exact namespaces and sockets were absent
cleanup.conntrack: whole owned namespaces were removed, releasing their private conntrack state
cleanup.host_preservation: unchanged IPv4/IPv6 routes, stateless nftables rule/object configuration, forwarding and rp_filter; background host counter values are excluded from configuration identity
cleanup.replacement_policy: foreign namespace, socket and lab-link replacements retain strict identity rejection and preservation

limitations: This is exact-source hosted mechanism evidence using fixed signed credentials; it does not execute management HTTP login or the production online one-use start/lease path.
Equal per-owner traffic accounting and consumed-journal replay rejection do not independently qualify coordinator-wide cumulative quota exhaustion or reset recovery.

The test does not qualify Windows subnet endpoints, standard WireGuard peers, physical two-device installations, external NAT/LAN sites, primary/standby recovery, deployment upgrades or cross-day stability.
The deliberately failed inner helper roles in SIGKILL/SIGSTOP scenarios are required failure injection, while the complete outer case, native execution and strict daemon lint all passed.
The subsequent slow-handshake challenge-consumption repair is outside this source revision and requires its own exact-source execution evidence.
